simple.meaning: to ooze , i.e. distil gradually ; by implication, to fall in drops ; figuratively, to speak by inspiration

definitions.short: to ooze , i.e. distil gradually ; by implication, to fall in drops ; figuratively, to speak by inspiration
definitions.full: H5197. nataph [ נָטַף ] verb drop, drip, figurative (especially of prophet) discourse (Late Hebrew id. ; נְטַף ᵑ7 drop, drip ; Syriac drip , drop (Nö Syr. Gr. § 105 ) etc.; Arabic id. ; Ethiopic id. , colare (stillando), expercolare ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine plural נָָֽטְפוּ Judg 5:4 2 t.; נָטָּ֑פוּ 5:4 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular תִּטֹּף Job 29:22 ; 3 masculine plural יִטּפוּ Joel 4:18; 3feminine plural תִּטֹּפְנָה Prov 5:3 ; Song 4:11 ; Participle נֹטְפוֺת 5:13 ; — drop, drip , usually transitive, with accusative, of clouds dropping water ( מַיִ ), in storm Judg 5:4 , || heavens 5:4 (object omitted), Psa 68:9 ( id. ; all theoph.); of hands dripping myrrh ( מוֺר ) Song 5:5 ; in predict. עָסִיס יִטְּפוּ Joel 4:18 the mountains shall drip must ; figurative of (seductive) speech תִּטּ ׳נֹפֶת Prov 5:3 the lips of the strange woman drop honey , so perhaps Song 4:11 (Bu of kisses); נ ׳שִׂפְתוֺתָיו מוֺר 5:13 his lips drip myrrh (perhaps of sweet breath). Intransitive only מִלָּתִי תִּטֹּף עָלֵימוֺ Job 29:22 upon them my speech used to drop. Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine plural וְהִטִּיפוּ consecutive Amos 9:13 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular תַּטִּיף 7:16 ; 1 singular אַטִּף Micah 2:11 ; 3 masculine plural יִטִּיפ֑וּן 2:6 ; 2 masculine plural תַּטִּיפוּ 2:6 , תַּטִּפוּ 2:6 ; Participle מַטִּיף 2:11 ; — 1 drip , ׳וְהַטּ עָסִיס Amos 9:13 and the mountains shall drip must (= Qal Joel 4:18). 2 of speech, especially prophecy (without accusative): with עַל against , Amos 7:16 (|| הִנָּבֵא ), with אֶלֿ toward, Exod 21:2 (|| id. ), 21:7 (|| id. ); with ל concerning Micah 2:11 compare 2:11 ; — לָאֵלֶּה לֹאיַֿטִּפוּ יַטִּיכּ֑וּן אַלתַּֿטִּפוּ 2:6 'talk not' — so they talk — ' they (read ye?) shall not talk of these things (where יַטִּפוּ ׳תַּטּ, reference to prophets).
